svg.aria-label: The same teaching temperature records in two time coordinates. Left: B starts 7 minutes after A. Right: subtracting each batch’s own start aligns process stage. Connecting segments trace neighboring records without adding observations between them. This is one explicit alignment supported by labeled temporal data.
